name: Women Teachers
overview: Scripture acknowledges the important role women play in teaching and supporting the spread of the gospel, as seen in Acts 18:26 where Priscilla, alongside Aquila, instructs Apollos more accurately in the way of God. Women are commended for their wisdom and kindness in Proverbs 31:26, reflecting qualities essential for godly teaching. Philippians 4:3 highlights women laboring alongside Paul in the gospel ministry, affirming their active participation in sound doctrine, which Titus 2:1 commands to be upheld. The Lord’s provision of messengers to proclaim His word, described in Psalms 68:11, includes a broad company, implicitly encompassing faithful women teachers who contribute to the spiritual growth of the church.
